substeps.caption: The hood lifts on its rear hinge, uncovering the XY Autochanger's 20-position tray.
A cup of atomized powder, closed underneath by a thin prolene film, goes into a free seat.
The changer takes the cup to the measuring position, film side down over the window: the tube and the detector are underneath. Helium at reduced pressure keeps loose powder in place.
The beam, drawn see-through: up to 50 kV and 50 W from the tube; each element in the powder answers with its own X-ray lines, which the silicon drift detector counts.
The spectrum: peaks at each element's lines give the composition, Na to Am, in minutes.
